title: The Paradox Floor Where Meaning Becomes Solid Stone

features.name: thesis-made-stone
features.desc-on-touch: The argument crystallized into bedrock, still holding its proof, though no one is left to argue. It stands uncontested, immovable, alone.

features.name: antithesis-made-stone
features.desc-on-touch: Standing opposite, the exact counter-stone, its proof equally certain, equally frozen. Between them: the space where argument can never resume.

features.name: the-merger-ground
features.desc-on-touch: Where thesis and antithesis met and refused to pass through each other. An archway of contradiction, both sides equal, both sides final, both sides real.

features.name: doubt-made-visible
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph carved into the stone between the two towers. Doubt—the third dancer no one invited—made manifest. It reads as both symbol and question.

features.name: the-dance-floor-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of compressed argument, so dense it has become reflective stone. Looking into it, you see thesis and antithesis waltzing forever, backward and forward, never arriving.

features.name: compressed-logic
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe of argument made manifest in stone, showing every possible path between thesis and antithesis meeting at the same impossible point, forever.

inscription: when argument learned to stop and hold its breath, it became ground that could be walked on

file.name: Paradox_Solidification_Geological_Survey.txt
file.note: A formal record of when thesis met antithesis and both refused to yield, creating a new kind of stone that cannot be broken because it contains its own contradiction.

exits.label: back upward to the basement where paradox still rehearses being a word
downward to the deepest paradox where contradiction has become breathable
toward the chamber where argument learned a third step
